observationsNotFindings: OBL-REPAIR-MEDIA's reason cites 'G08 doesNotClaim includes "Does not name a repair-media harness."' G08 v2 has no key literally named doesNotClaim — the array is named doesNot, and the quoted sentence is exactly its member [6]. I traced the token: doesNotClaim appears inside basedOn.namingV6.role, quoting naming v6's vocabulary, in the sentence 'doesNotClaim QUALIFIED. Does not name a repair-media harness.' — so the label is borrowed from the adjacent quoted context rather than invented. Not a finding: the quoted string is verbatim present, the proposition is true and independently corroborated at multiple sites in G08 (dr110Split, removableMediaIsNotRepairMedia, dr103Split, and doesNot[6]), and the citation is traceable either way. The subject is otherwise precise with G08 key names (leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded, leftoverNameNote, dr112Split, reservedNumbersRemainReserved all verified exact), so this is a single loose label, carried byte-identically from the ACCEPTed v2.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Nineteen attacks run, nineteen refuted. The subject is a genuine remeasurement of frozen v2 onto live HEAD afb115d / file 08 f909ddff / required-now 28, with the 26→28 delta accounted for by D-167 and D-169 and file 08 confirmed moved. Both self-declared repairs landed with no residual text, and the nine-obligation leftoverDesign set is provably identical to v2. The two reservation surfaces that matter on this row hold: all four OD-112 reserved numbers are byte-identical to G08 v2's own field, and the four corpus classes match G08 v2, the catalog, and the live register cell. The artifact mints no number beyond its version and the required-now count. One loose field label (doesNotClaim for G08's doesNot array) is logged as an observation — the quoted sentence is verbatim present and the proposition is corroborated at four independent sites in G08.
